questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 Don Swanson, Manager, Wallace Fitness Center

All members of Wallace Fitness Center

Feedback requested

November 4th, 2:00 p.m.
Dear members,

First, I’d like to thank you for choosing Wallace Fitness Center. We value your membership. Our 10th anniversary is coming up next month, and we’re planning to run some special events. Before that, we’d like to know what our members think about our center. Please take a moment to share your opinion with us. Any feedback or suggestions about our service and facilities are welcome. We thank you for your time and look forward to hearing from you soon.

 

Sincerely,

Don Swanson, Manager

 
Directions: Respond to this email as if you are a member at Wallace Fitness Center. In your email, give TWO pieces of information and make ONE suggestion.
questions.model_answer:
Dear Mr. Swanson, Lời chào
I am writing in response to your reqeust for feedback. Overall, I feel very satisfied with Wallace Fitness Center (thông tin 1). The equipment is very modern and clean, and there’s plenty of space to exercise, even when there are a lot of people in the center (thông tin 2). By the way, there’s just one thing missing: a snack bar (gợi ý). The most luxurious fitness centers all have snack bars these days, where members can get fresh juice, protein bars, and other healthy snacks after working out. If Wallace Fitness Center installed a snack bar, it would really be perfect. Thank you for considering my suggestion. - Thông tin 1: Nhìn chung thì tôi rất hài lòng với trung tâm. - Thông tin 2: Cơ sở vật chất hiện đại và đẹp, rộng rãi để tập luyện. - Gợi ý: Mong muốn có thêm khu ăn uống.
Sincerely, Jenny Jones Ký tên

questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 John Sheridan, Chief Editor, Summit Publishing

Owners of local restaurants

Guidebooks

July 10, 11:00 a.m.
Dear Local Owners,

Our company, Summit Publishing, has specialized in publishing guidebooks for several decades. Providing information about local restaurants is one of the primary objectives of these books. If you would like us to include information about your restaurant in our upcoming editions, please send specific details to us. Thank you.

Sincerely,

John Sheridan, Chief Editor
Directions: Respond to this e-mail as if you are one of the local restaurant’s owners. In your e-mail, ask TWO questions and give ONE piece of information.
questions.model_answer:
Dear Mr. Sheridan, Lời chào
Thank you for offering to include our restaurant in your guidebook. This would be a great opportunity for us, as we are a fairly new business working hard to make a name for ourselves (thông tin). However, I was wondering about a few things. First, are there any requirements that we need to meet in order to be included (câu hỏi 1)? Also, when is the new edition going to be published (câu hỏi 2)? Thank you again for your interest in our establishment. I hope to hear from you soon. - Lý do: Chúng tôi dừng sử dụng dịch vụ vì chúng tôi không thích hoa mà bạn đã trồng - Lý do 2: Tôi đã e-mail bà bảo bạn bỏ cái cây chết nhưng cái cây vẫn ở đó. - Gợi ý: Nên lắng nghe khách hàng
Sincerely, Lindsay Grayson, Owner, Twilight Bistro Ký tên

questions.question: In your opinion, which is more beneficial for children: playing sports or studying a foreign language? Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
questions.model_answer:
Đáp án 1:
Mở bài I think playing sports is more beneficial. Children need a break from studying, and sports can help give them a break. Also sports teach many important skills, like teamwork. Trình bày các luận điểm: - Cho trẻ em thời gian nghỉ ngơi - Dạy các kỹ năng quan trọng
Thân bài 1 (Cho thời gian nghỉ ngơi) First, children spend a lot of time in school, so they should have some time to have fun and relax. Life is not just about studying, and like everybody, children deserve to enjoy their lives. Sports involve exercise and interacting with others, which most children find enjoyable. Also, break times actually make it easier for them to study in the long run. When I play sports, it helps me clear my head, and then I can focus when it's time for me to work again. Playing sports also reduces stress, so when I start my work again, I feel more relaxed. If I didn't play sports, I would probably burn out in just a few months. While studying a foreign language does give you opportunities to socialize, it is still a form of studying. Therefore, it'does not give you a break the way that playing sports does. - Phân tích: Cuộc đời không chỉ có mỗi việc học và trẻ em cũng xứng đáng được tận hướng cuộc sống. Tập luyện thể thao là luyện tập và tương tác với người khác, điều mà nhiều trẻ em thấy hứng thú. Thời gian nghỉ làm trẻ em học dễ dàng hơn. - Ví dụ: Khi tôi chơi thể thao, nó giúp tôi thư giãn và có thể tập trung khi tôi quay lại làm việc. Chơi thể thao giúp giảm stress, vậy khi tôi bắt đầu làm việc trở lại, tôi thấy thư giãn hơn. Nếu tôi không chơi thể thao, tôi sẽ cạn kiệt sức lực sau vài tháng. Học tiếng nước ngoài vẫn là một hình thức học và không được nghỉ ngơi.
Thân bài 2 (Thoái mái nói hơn) Sports also teach important skills like teamwork and time management. Most sports are team sports, and when children play them, they learn how to work well on a team. They practice leadership, compromising, and using their skills to support others. These are all really valuable skills for school and work, too. Through sports, children also learn how to budget their time so that they can practice and get their schoolwork done. Being able to balance different commitments like this will come in handy in many situations. Studying a foreign language doesn't give any special advantages in these areas. - Phân tích: Hầu như các môn thể thao là các môn đồng đội, và khi trẻ em chơi thì sẽ học được cách làm việc nhóm. Chúng học được kỹ năng lãnh đạo, đàm phán và sử dụng kỹ năng để hỗ trợ người khác. Trẻ em còn học được cách quản lý thời gian nên chúng sẽ luyện tập và làm việc ở trường xong. Biết cách cân bằng sẽ rất thuận tiện.
Kết bài For these reasons, I believe that sports are more beneficial than studying a foreign language. Sports help give students a break and teach them a lot of important things. Tổng hợp luận điểm và nêu quan điểm cá nhân.
  Đáp án 2:
Mở bài While both activities are important, I think it is more beneficial for children to study a foreign language. Studying a foreign language will help kids socially and professionally, while sports just help kids socially. Trình bày các luận điểm: - Về mặt xã hội - Về mặt chuyên môn
Thân bài 1 (Xã hội) First, studying a foreign language will help kids socially, because they can communicate with more people. If children can speak multiple languages, then they can make friends with more people. If they only speak one language, it will be harder for them to make friends with kids who speak different languages. They'll also learn about other cultures, which will also make it easier for them to understand and make friends with all different types of people. Playing sports can also help kids develop social skills, but some kids are not very good at sports. For these kids, the social benefits of sports will not last very long, since sports become more competitive as kids get older. - Phân tích: Vì chúng sẽ biết cách giao tiếp với nhiều người hơn. Nếu trẻ em biết nói nhiều ngôn ngữ, chúng sẽ kết bạn với nhiều người hơn. Nếu chỉ nói 1 thứ tiếng, sẽ khó hơn để kết bạn với những người mà nói thứ tiếng khác. Chúng còn học được về văn hóa khác, điều mà cũng làm chúng dễ hiểu và kết bạn với nhiều người. Chơi thể thao cũng giúp trẻ em phát triển kỹ năng xã hội, nhưng không phải ai cũng giỏi thể thao.
Thân bài 2 (Chuyên môn) Another reason studying a foreign language is more beneficial is that it will help children learn the language fluently, and eventually knowing the language will help them professionally. Many large companies have offices all over the world, and those companies like to hire employees that can speak different languages. Even if a company doesn't have an office in a particular country, it may do business with people in that country. For example, my company does not have an office in France, but they sell clothing to stores in France, so they need employees who speak French. In contrast, there are very few situations in which being able to play sports helps people succeed professionally. - Phân tích: Nhiều công ty lớn có văn phòng khắp thế giới, và những công ty đó thích thuê nhân viên biết nói nhiều ngôn ngữ. Kể cả khi công ty không có văn phòng ở một nước cụ thể, nhưng họ cũng có thể làm việc với người từ nước đó. Ví dụ, công ty tôi không có văn phòng ở Pháp nhưng vẫn bán quần áo ở Pháp, nên cần nhân viên nói tiếng Pháp. Ngược lại, có ít trường hợp chơi thể thao giúp mọi người thành công theo hướng chuyên nghiệp.
Kết bài Some people may believe that it is more important for children to play sports, but I think they benefit more from studying a foreign language. Studying a foreign language will help them socially and professionally, but sports are really just for socializing. Tổng hợp luận điểm và nêu quan điểm cá nhân.

intro.content:
Question 1-5: Write a sentence based on a picture

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write ONE sentence that is based on a picture. With each picture, you will be given TWO words or phrases that you must use in your sentence. You can change the forms of the words and you can use the words in any order. Your sentences will be scored on

  • the appropriate use of grammar and
  • the relevance of the sentence to the picture

In this part, you can move to the next question by clicking on Next. If you want to return to a previous question, click on Back. You will have 8 minutes to complete this part of the test.

Example

 Sample response: This man is writing in a notebook.

Question 6-7: Respond to a written request

Directions: In this part of the test, you will show how well you can write a response to an e-mail.

Your response will be scored on

  • the quality and variety of your sentence,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 10 minutes to read and answer each e-mail

Click on Continue to go on.

Question 8: Write an opinion essay

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write an essay in response to a question that asks you to state, explain, and support your opinion on an issue. Typically, an effective essay will contain a minimum of 300 words. Your response will be scored on

  • whether your opinion is supported with reasons and/or examples.
  • grammar,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 30 minutes to plan, write, and revise your essay.

Click on Continue to go on.
